cards.ex: Cross-border trade has become much easier with the advent of e-commerce.
cards.exUz: Elektron tijorat paydo bo'lishi bilan chegaralararo savdo ancha osonlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir davlatdan boshqa davlatga tovar yoki xizmatlar sotish yoki olish.

cards.ex: Trade liberalization can lead to increased economic growth, but it also has its downsides.
cards.exUz: Savdo erkinligi iqtisodiy o'sishga olib kelishi mumkin, ammo uning kamchiliklari ham bor.
cards.uzDef: Savdoni cheklovchi qoidalarni kamaytirish yoki bekor qilish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Global interconnectedness means that a crisis in one country can quickly spread to others.
cards.exUz: Global bog'liqlik bir mamlakatdagi inqiroz boshqalarga tez tarqalishi mumkin degan ma'noni anglatadi.
cards.uzDef: Mamlakatlar va xalqlar o'rtasidagi kuchli o'zaro bog'liqlik holati.

cards.ex: The debate about open borders is complex, with strong arguments on both sides.
cards.exUz: Ochiq chegaralar haqidagi bahs murakkab, har ikki tomonda ham kuchli dalillar mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Chegara nazorati juda kam yoki umuman yo'q bo'lgan davlat chegaralari.

cards.ex: The government provided subsidies to the infant industry to help it grow.
cards.exUz: Hukumat yosh sanoatning rivojlanishiga yordam berish uchun subsidiyalar berdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi rivojlanayotgan va himoyaga muhtoj bo'lgan sanoat tarmog'i.

cards.ex: A decline in the terms of trade can hurt a country's economy.
cards.exUz: Savdo shartlarining yomonlashuvi mamlakat iqtisodiyotiga zarar etkazishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Mamlakat eksport narxlarining import narxlariga nisbati.

cards.ex: Small businesses often bear the brunt of economic downturns.
cards.exUz: Kichik bizneslar ko'pincha iqtisodiy tanazzulning asosiy zarbasini oladilar.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik yoki zararli ta'sirning asosiy qismini boshdan kechirish.

cards.ex: The company is facing global headwinds due to rising inflation.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya inflyatsiya ko'tarilishi tufayli global qarshiliklarga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Global iqtisodiyotga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatuvchi omillar.

cards.ex: Capital flight can destabilize a country's financial system.
cards.exUz: Kapital qochishi mamlakatning moliyaviy tizimini beqarorlashtirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Investorlar kapitalni mamlakatdan olib chiqib ketishi.

cards.ex: Economic interdependence can promote peace and stability.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy o'zaro bog'liqlik tinchlik va barqarorlikni rag'batlantirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Mamlakatlar iqtisodiyoti o'zaro bog'liq bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: The EU is a powerful trade bloc.
cards.exUz: Evropa Ittifoqi kuchli savdo bloki hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro savdoni osonlashtirish uchun birlashgan davlatlar guruhi.

cards.ex: Supply-side economics focuses on cutting taxes and regulations.
cards.exUz: Taklif iqtisodiyoti soliqlar va tartiblarni kamaytirishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiyotni taklif orqali rag'batlantirishga qaratilgan siyosat.

cards.ex: Trade negotiations can be complex and time-consuming.
cards.exUz: Savdo muzokaralari murakkab va ko'p vaqt talab qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Savdo shartnomalarini tuzish bo'yicha davlatlar o'rtasidagi muzokaralar.

cards.ex: The global value chain has made it possible to produce goods at lower costs.
cards.exUz: Global qiymat zanjiri tovarlarni arzonroq narxlarda ishlab chiqarish imkonini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Tovarlarni ishlab chiqarish uchun turli mamlakatlarda bajariladigan bosqichlar.

cards.ex: Protectionist measures can harm international trade.
cards.exUz: Protektsion choralar xalqaro savdoga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Mahalliy sanoatni himoya qilish uchun qilingan harakatlar.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha bizneslar uchun teng imkoniyatlar yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Barcha ishtirokchilar uchun adolatli sharoitlar yaratish.

cards.ex: Many small businesses went bust during the recession.
cards.exUz: Tanazzul davrida ko'plab kichik bizneslar bankrot bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Pul yo'qligi sababli biznesni yopish.

cards.ex: The company managed to ride out the storm and stay afloat.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bo'ronni yengib o'tishga va suzib yurishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni muvaffaqiyatli boshdan kechirish.

cards.ex: The company is trying to corner the market for electric vehicles.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya elektr transport vositalari bozorini egallashga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bozorning katta qismini nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: Beggar-thy-neighbor policies can lead to trade wars.
cards.exUz: Qo'shnini kambag'allashtirish siyosati savdo urushlariga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa davlatlarga zarar yetkazish orqali iqtisodiyotni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: The race to the top can lead to innovation and economic growth.
cards.exUz: Yuqoriga intilish innovatsiya va iqtisodiy o'sishga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi bo'lish uchun raqobatlashish.

cards.ex: Tariff hikes can increase prices for consumers.
cards.exUz: Tariflarning oshishi iste'molchilar uchun narxlarni oshirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Import qilinadigan tovarlarga qo'yiladigan soliqlar ko'payishi.

cards.ex: The trade dispute between the two countries is affecting global markets.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat o'rtasidagi savdo bahsi global bozorlarga ta'sir qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Davlatlar o'rtasidagi savdo kelishmovchiligi.

cards.ex: Currency devaluation can make exports more competitive.
cards.exUz: Valyuta qadrsizlanishi eksportni raqobatbardoshroq qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Milliy valyuta qiymatining pasayishi.

cards.ex: Governments often protect infant industries with tariffs.
cards.exUz: Hukumatlar ko'pincha yangi sanoatlarni tariflar bilan himoya qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi rivojlanayotgan va himoyaga muhtoj sanoat tarmoqlari.

cards.ex: Global sourcing can help companies reduce costs.
cards.exUz: Global manba topish kompaniyalarga xarajatlarni kamaytirishga yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tovarlar va xizmatlarni butun dunyo bo'ylab topish.

cards.ex: Brain drain can hurt a country's economy in the long run.
cards.exUz: Aqlli quvvat yo'qolishi mamlakat iqtisodiyotiga uzoq muddatda zarar yetkazishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Malakali ishchilarning boshqa mamlakatlarga ketishi.

cards.ex: The current global economic order is facing unprecedented challenges.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi jahon iqtisodiy tartibi misli ko'rilmagan qiyinchiliklarga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Dunyo miqyosidagi iqtisodiy munosabatlar va qoidalar tizimi.

cards.ex: There's always a trade-off between economic growth and environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy o'sish va atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish o'rtasida har doim o'zaro kelishuv bor.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani qurbon qilib, boshqa narsaga erishish.

cards.ex: The new policy is designed to spur economic growth in the region.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat mintaqada iqtisodiy o'sishni rag'batlantirish uchun mo'ljallangan.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiyotning tez rivojlanishiga yordam bermoq.
